description: Adds CV control of one parameter of any module, with offset, scaling and an output following that parameter.

params.text: Binds a parameter: press it, then click a knob, fader or switch on any module.
Offsets the input by 0% to 100% of its range.

inputs.text: Sets the offset added to the input, 0-10V mapping onto 0% to 100%, and takes the offset trimpot out of use.
Sets the scaling of the input, -10V to 10V mapping onto -200% to 200%, and takes the scale trimpot out of use.
Sets the mapped parameter; 0-10V, or -5V to 5V on the menu.

outputs.text: Carries the value of the mapped parameter as a voltage, in the range picked for the input port, and inverted when the menu says so.

notes: nothing is controlled until the mapping button is pressed and a knob, fader or switch on another module is clicked.
menu: Parameter changes — set to Locked, the mapped parameter cannot be moved by hand; set to Unlocked, it can, for as long as the input voltage stays where it is.
Voltage range — reads the input port as 0V..10V or as -5V..5V.
OUT-port — sends the mapped parameter's value as it is, or inverted.
Audio rate processing — switched off, the mapped parameter is updated every 32nd sample instead of every sample.
